page.layout: One printed page. Running head centred at top with Hebrew subtitle line below it. Page number top right. A calendar table of columns in the centre: left column of month and date labels with the year 1636, a narrow column of day numbers (Dies.), a column of Caslev day numbers with Sabbath and feast notes, and a right-hand column of explanatory text beside the table. Below the table a catchword-like word at the lower right.

main_text.head: Mensis Tertius.
main_text.l: 1636. | Dies. | 3. CASLEV dierum 30. | Nonus in anno sacro.
main_text.p: Hic Mensis כִּסְלֵו In anno Deficiente minuitur uno die, qui annus tres habet menses continue cavos, secundum tertium & quartum. Reliqui menses praeter secundum & tertiū, nullam admittunt in numerro dierum mutationem.
Die 28. Iojakim combussit volumen quod scripserat Baruch dictante Ieremia. Jerem. 36.

page.notes: Table layout is approximate; the table is rendered as lines with cells separated by " | ". The Hebrew word beside "Hic Mensis" is printed Hebrew (Kislev). The "Character hoc anno" line is partly illegible in the scan and the reading is uncertain. Left faint show-through from the facing page omitted. Catchword "Mensis" at lower right.
